languageTab.controlsTheOnDemandTranslationFeatureOnS: Controls the on-demand translation feature on shared documents. Doctors viewing a share link see a dropdown listing the allowed languages with the default pre-selected. Changing these settings does not retranslate documents that have already been translated.
languageTab.theStartingSelectionForTheDoctorSTransla: The starting selection for the doctor's translation picker. Must be one of the allowed languages below.
languageTab.pickTheLanguagesDoctorsCanChooseFromAt: Pick the languages doctors can choose from. At least one must be allowed; the current default cannot be removed without first picking a different default.
languageTab.pickAtLeastOneAllowedLanguageAndA: Pick at least one allowed language and a valid default.

normalizationTab.normalizationMapsDifferentNamesForTheSam: Normalization maps different names for the same medical concept (e.g. "CBC", "Complete Blood Count", "Emocromo") to a single canonical entry. Click a row to view and manage its aliases, edit the canonical name, or merge duplicates.

oidcTab.showSignInWithSsoOnTheLogin: Show 'Sign in with SSO' on the login page
oidcTab.whenSsoIsEnabledHideTheUsernamePassword: When SSO is enabled, hide the username/password form on the login page. The login API stays available so an admin can still recover if the IDP is down.
oidcTab.addGroupsWhenSyncingRolesSoTheProvider: Add 'groups' when syncing roles so the provider returns group membership
oidcTab.createALocalUserOnFirstOidcLogin: Create a local user on first OIDC login. Auto-created users start with the 'editor' role unless 'Sync roles on login' below maps them to admin. Promote them via the Users tab if needed.
oidcTab.name: name
oidcTab.whenEnabledAUserSLocalRoleIs: When enabled, a user's local role is recomputed on every OIDC login from the provider's group/role claim. First match wins in the order admin, editor, viewer.
oidcTab.overwriteTheLocalRoleFromOidcGroupsOn: Overwrite the local role from OIDC groups on every login
oidcTab.dottedPathAuthentikGroupsKeycloakRealmRo: Dotted path. Authentik: 'groups'. Keycloak realm roles: 'realm_access.roles'.
oidcTab.commaSeparatedListOfOidcGroupRoleNames: Comma-separated list of OIDC group/role names that map to admin
oidcTab.commaSeparatedListOfOidcGroupRoleNames2: Comma-separated list of OIDC group/role names that map to editor
oidcTab.commaSeparatedListOfOidcGroupRoleNames3: Comma-separated list of OIDC group/role names that map to viewer
oidcTab.appliedWhenSyncIsOnAndNoMapping: Applied when sync is on and no mapping matches. Use admin, editor, or viewer.

priorityTab.usedForChatAutoMergeAutoRenameLink: — used for chat, auto-merge, auto-rename, link suggestions, event extraction, document-edit AI
priorityTab.notConfiguredThoseFeaturesWillReturn503U: Not configured — those features will return 503 until you pick a provider and model.
priorityTab.noLlmModelsOnThisProvider: — no LLM models on this provider —
priorityTab.addAnLlmModelToThisProviderUnder: Add an LLM model to this provider under <part0> Providers </part0> .
priorityTab.inheritsPart0Part0ConcurrentRequestsPart: Inherits <part0>{{value0}}</part0> concurrent requests / <part1>{{value1}}</part1> retries from provider <part2> {{value2}} </part2> .
priorityTab.usedWhenAdminsOrDoctorsTranslateADocumen: — used when admins or doctors translate a document or region
priorityTab.theseProvidersAreUsedForEveryTranslateAc: These providers are used for every translate action <part0>unless</part0> something more specific is set. From most-specific to least:
priorityTab.aOneOffPickFromTheAdminTranslate: A one-off pick from the admin Translate dropdown on a document.
priorityTab.thePerSharePreferenceSavedWhenCreatingA: The per-share preference saved when creating a doctor share.
priorityTab.part0TheseSettingsPart0UsedWheneverNeith: <part0>These settings</part0>, used whenever neither of the above applies.
priorityTab.theFirstEnabledEntryInThePriorityList: The first enabled entry in the priority list, as a final fallback.
priorityTab.setTheseToPinASpecificOcrLlm: Set these to pin a specific OCR / LLM for translation across the board, without remembering to pick it every time.
priorityTab.part0PriorityPart0ControlsWhichModelIsTr: <part0>Priority</part0> controls which model is tried first for each task. Providers are defined under <part1> Providers </part1> .
priorityTab.noLlmModelsAddOneUnderProviders: No LLM models — add one under Providers.

promptsTab.everyFreeFormFieldProducedByTheLlm: Every free-form field produced by the LLM (summaries, canonical names, findings, notes, etc.) will be written in this language, regardless of the document's source language. Codes (ICD-10, LOINC, ISO 4217, etc.) are always kept as-is.
promptsTab.customizeTheLlmPromptsUsedForDocumentCla: Customize the LLM prompts used for document classification, extraction, chat, and more. Prompts are Python <part0>str.format()</part0> templates — expand a prompt to see the exact <part1>{{value0}}</part1> placeholders it supports. Click a prompt to edit it. Reset to revert to the default.
promptsTab.clickAChipToCopyThePlaceholderVariables: Click a chip to copy the placeholder. Variables marked with <part0>?</part0> are optional — substituted only if the placeholder actually appears in the template. Using an unknown placeholder will break extraction.

credentialDialog.sharedAcrossEveryModelThatUsesThisProvid: Shared across every model that uses this provider.
credentialDialog.transientFailurePolicyForThisConnectionC: Transient-failure policy for this connection. Claude / OpenAI rate limits and Ollama timeouts can differ; tune per provider.

providersTab.aPart0ProviderPart0IsAConnectionCredenti: A <part0>provider</part0> is a connection (credentials + concurrency + retry policy). Under each provider, list the models it exposes - LLM, Vision, or OCR. Ranking and task assignment happens on the <part1> Priority</part1> tab.
providersTab.addAProviderToGetStarted: Add a provider to get started.

sessionsTab.filterByUserIpOrBrowser: Filter by user, IP, or browser...

smtpTab.whenOffTheEmailOtpShareDeliveryIs: When off, the email-OTP share delivery is unavailable and the share dialog disables that option.
smtpTab.leaveBlankToKeepTheCurrentPassword: Leave blank to keep the current password.
smtpTab.sendsAFixedDiagnosticMessageViaTheCurren: Sends a fixed diagnostic message via the current SMTP settings. Useful right after entering a password or changing TLS mode.
smtpTab.subject: Subject
smtpTab.revokeShareAfterNConsecutiveFailedOtpAtt: Revoke share after N consecutive failed OTP attempts
smtpTab.appliesToBothManualAndEmailOtpShares: Applies to BOTH manual and email-OTP shares. Below the threshold the per-code attempt cap still rejects the wrong code; at the threshold the share itself is revoked and all sessions are killed.
smtpTab.emailOtpDailyCapPerShare: Email OTP daily cap per share
smtpTab.hardCeilingOnAutomatedEmailsPerSharePer: Hard ceiling on automated emails per share per 24 h. Belt-and-braces against inbox flooding via a leaked URL.
smtpTab.minimumGapBetweenTwoRequestOtpCallsOn: Minimum gap between two request-otp calls on the same share.

usersTab.onlyAdministratorsCanListAndManageUsersS: Only administrators can list and manage users. Sign in as an admin (or ask one to grant you the admin role) to use this page.
usersTab.part0AdminPart0FullAccessSettingsUserMan: <part0>Admin:</part0> Full access — settings, user management, all patients.
usersTab.part0EditorPart0CanViewEditDocumentsAnd: <part0>Editor:</part0> Can view/edit documents and patients they have access to.

viewColumnsTab.pickWhichColumnsAppearInEachListView: Pick which columns appear in each list view, and reorder them. Saves automatically.
viewColumnsTab.labTestsViewUsesAGroupedLayoutNot: Lab tests view uses a grouped layout (not a flat column list) and isn't configurable from here yet. It's tracked for the next release.

variables.ocr_text: Full OCR-extracted text of the document.
variables.pages_text: Multi-page OCR text, formatted as `--- PAGE N ---\n<text>`.
variables.patient_list: JSON list of known patients (id, slug, name, DOB, sex).
variables.facility_list: JSON list of known facilities (id, slug, name).
variables.doctor_list: JSON list of known doctors (id, slug, name).
variables.few_shot_examples: 1–2 similar prior documents with their extractions, used as in-context examples.
variables.lab_test_mappings: JSON list of canonical lab-test aliases. Substituted only if the placeholder appears in the template.
variables.specialty_mappings: JSON list of canonical specialty aliases. Substituted only if the placeholder appears in the template.
variables.diagnosis_mappings: JSON list of canonical diagnosis/ICD-10 aliases. Substituted only if the placeholder appears in the template.
variables.medication_mappings: JSON list of canonical medication aliases. Substituted only if the placeholder appears in the template.
variables.doc_date: Canonical event date (YYYY-MM-DD or 'unknown'). Placeholder name kept for template compat; value comes from documents.event_date.
variables.doctor_name: Treating/signing doctor's name from the extraction.
variables.other_documents: Text list of other documents belonging to the same patient.
variables.schema: SQLite schema (tables + columns) for SQL generation.
variables.context: Patient context snippet used by chat and SQL generation.
variables.question: User's natural-language question (chat).
variables.patient_context: Formatted patient demographics + recent history (chat system prompt).
variables.current_data: Current document extraction rendered as JSON (document_edit).
